definition.zh-TW: 把一段期間真正收到與付出的現金，按三類活動分開列：營業活動是做生意本身的現金進出，投資活動是買賣設備等長期資產的現金，籌資活動是向銀行與股東拿錢或還錢。三類相加就是這段期間現金的增減，加上期初現金便得到期末現金。它不理會賒帳，只認真的錢。
definition.en: Sets out the cash actually received and paid during a period under three headings: operating activities are the cash movements of the business itself, investing activities are the cash spent on or recovered from equipment and other long-term assets, and financing activities are money raised from or returned to banks and shareholders. The three together give the period's change in cash; add opening cash and you reach closing cash. Credit is ignored; only real money counts.
